description: List EVERY vetted, type-checked blueprint available to reuse — working functionality (gift cards, loyalty, payment surfaces, product grids, carts, customer views, order tickets, receipts), not just screen layouts. Check the catalog BEFORE creating custom tables or hand-rolling a capability. Returns id, kind, slot, title, summary, surfaces, tags, and selfPersisting per blueprint — selfPersisting: true means it reads/writes its OWN custom tables by exact name inside its code, which applying then provisions in your organization automatically (some are extension-owned and come from installing that extension); never create a table for a feature it covers. TWO KINDS, used differently: kind "widget-set" (the default this returns) is a set of parts you copy into an existing build with apply_blueprint_widgets; kind "fbb" is a Final Business Blueprint — a COMPLETE APP. It has no widgets to copy and is used with create_flow_from_blueprint to start a NEW flow. Pass kind: "fbb" to browse complete apps, or kind: "any" for both. To find the best match for a specific capability instead of scanning the whole catalog, use search_blueprints. get_blueprint is read-only inspection.
name: flow_list_blueprints
title: List the blueprint catalog
